svg.title: Four Checks Before Capital Leaves the Account
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-05-preflight-risk-decisions; chart type: decision_tree; title: Four Checks Before Capital Leaves the Account; subtitle: Proceed sequentially; any failed check stops that transaction.; chapter number: 5; epistemic tag: operating_framework; assumptions note: Four ordered decision nodes. A pass advances to the next node; a failure routes to the corrective action in its detail. Sources establish statutory context, while seller, issuer, carrier, and buying-group contracts supply transaction terms.; caption: Tax documentation, loss allocation, reward records, and repayment liquidity must each stand independently.; stages: label: Destination and resale treatment; value: Pass with documented sourcing and destination treatment; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Verify DE, NH, or OR delivery and applicable seller collection rules; retain valid resale certificates where required. Oregon's general sales-tax position appears in ORS 305.620. If treatment is unresolved, price tax into the order or defer the purchase.; label: Commitment and shipment exposure; value: Pass with written acceptance and recoverable loss exposure; numeric value: 2.0; detail: Apply the contract's loss allocation against UCC 2-509 defaults. Verify carrier coverage exclusions, declared-value limits, claim deadlines, and inspection rights. If uninsured exposure exceeds the loss budget, reduce shipment size or reject the commitment.; label: Permitted payment and reward records; value: Pass with genuine spend and auditable reward treatment; numeric value: 3.0; detail: Confirm issuer and payment-provider permission for the transaction; exclude prohibited consumer card-cycling and circular manufactured payments. Retain basis records under 26 U.S.C. 1012 and reconcile applicable 1099-K reporting under 26 U.S.C. 6050W without equating receipts to profit.; label: Due-date liquidity and concentration; value: Pass only when stressed repayment remains fully funded; numeric value: 4.0; detail: For a $10,000 charge due on day 55, delay expected Net-5 ACH by another 60 days and assume a $500 shipping or return loss. Require $10,500 unrestricted cash plus other due obligations. Otherwise reduce the purchase; do not rely on a new card charge or an unsettled Treasury sale to make repayment.

text.tspan: Four Checks Before Capital Leaves the Account

circle.title: label: Destination and resale treatment; value: Pass with documented sourcing and destination treatment; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Verify DE, NH, or OR delivery and applicable seller collection rules; retain valid resale certificates where required. Oregon's general sales-tax position appears in ORS 305.620. If treatment is unresolved, price tax into the order or defer the purchase.

circle.title: label: Commitment and shipment exposure; value: Pass with written acceptance and recoverable loss exposure; numeric value: 2.0; detail: Apply the contract's loss allocation against UCC 2-509 defaults. Verify carrier coverage exclusions, declared-value limits, claim deadlines, and inspection rights. If uninsured exposure exceeds the loss budget, reduce shipment size or reject the commitment.

circle.title: label: Permitted payment and reward records; value: Pass with genuine spend and auditable reward treatment; numeric value: 3.0; detail: Confirm issuer and payment-provider permission for the transaction; exclude prohibited consumer card-cycling and circular manufactured payments. Retain basis records under 26 U.S.C. 1012 and reconcile applicable 1099-K reporting under 26 U.S.C. 6050W without equating receipts to profit.

Require $10,500 unrestricted cash plus other due obligations. Otherwise reduce the purchase; do not rely on a new card charge or an unsettled Treasury sale to make repayment.
